evidence: empty_void: At seg2:start the bars fill only the bottom third and the top half is empty gradient. At seg3:start and seg4:start two small discs sit in a mostly empty frame.

weakest_scene.visible_evidence: seg3:start, seg3:mid and seg3:end show two identical teal discs, both reading '127%' and both labelled 'Billionaire wealth'. The narration says the S&P 500 grew 195%, but 195% never appears on screen.
weakest_scene.root_cause: The comparison composer filled both sides from the same series, so the S&P 500 value and label never reached the right-hand mark. The pulsing size of the discs encodes no value.
weakest_scene.repair_goal: Show billionaire wealth +127% against the S&P 500 +195% as two marks scaled to their values, with the S&P side visibly ahead and labelled correctly. Have Data push or pump the larger one so it outgrows the other, making the point that most of the gain is just stocks.
